chapter_note: Chapter on the First Man — heavily damaged (85% damage ratio) but the surviving content is overwhelmingly cosmological substrate. Teaching describes the First Man's descent against Darkness, the quenching of the living fire, the four garments (wind, water, light, air) given as helpers, the wounding of the powers, and the stripping of the air-garment. Only the chapter heading and the standard 'Once again the Illuminator said' formula are editorial framing. Teaching purity 0.826 confirms substrate dominance.
